```{r}
as_flag <- function(x) {
  if (is.logical(x)) {
    return(
      replace(
        x,
        is.na(x),
        FALSE
      )
    )
  }

  if (is.numeric(x)) {
    return(
      !is.na(x) &
        x != 0
    )
  }

  tolower(
    trimws(
      as.character(x)
    )
  ) %in% c(
    "true",
    "t",
    "1",
    "yes",
    "y"
  )
}


canonical_contrast <- function(x) {
  x <- as.character(x)

  x <- str_replace_all(
    x,
    "[^A-Za-z0-9]+",
    "_"
  )

  x <- str_replace_all(
    x,
    "_+",
    "_"
  )

  str_remove_all(
    x,
    "^_|_$"
  )
}


find_column <- function(
    data,
    candidates,
    description,
    required = TRUE
) {
  found <- candidates[
    candidates %in%
      names(data)
  ]

  if (
    length(found) == 0 &&
    required
  ) {
    stop(
      "Could not find ",
      description,
      ". Available columns: ",
      paste(
        names(data),
        collapse = ", "
      )
    )
  }

  if (length(found) == 0) {
    return(NULL)
  }

  found[1]
}


fdr_to_stars <- function(x) {
  case_when(
    is.na(x) ~ NA_character_,
    x <= 0.001 ~ "***",
    x <= 0.01 ~ "**",
    x <= 0.05 ~ "*",
    TRUE ~ "ns"
  )
}


save_placeholder_svg <- function(
    file,
    title,
    detail
) {
  p <- ggplot() +
    annotate(
      "text",
      x = 0,
      y = 0.12,
      label = title,
      fontface = "bold",
      size = 5
    ) +
    annotate(
      "text",
      x = 0,
      y = -0.12,
      label = detail,
      size = 4
    ) +
    xlim(-1, 1) +
    ylim(-1, 1) +
    theme_void()

  ggsave(
    file,
    p,
    width = 7,
    height = 5,
    device = "svg"
  )

  invisible(p)
}
```

```{r}
read_primary_de <- function(
    file,
    molecule,
    dataset
) {
  data <- read.csv(
    file,
    row.names = 1,
    check.names = FALSE,
    stringsAsFactors = FALSE
  ) %>%
    rownames_to_column(
      if (
        molecule == "mRNA"
      ) {
        "Gene"
      } else {
        "pre_miRNA"
      }
    ) %>%
    as_tibble()

  required_statistics <- c(
    "logFC",
    "PValue",
    "FDR"
  )

  missing_statistics <- setdiff(
    required_statistics,
    names(data)
  )

  if (length(missing_statistics) > 0) {
    stop(
      "Primary ",
      molecule,
      " result for ",
      dataset,
      " is missing columns: ",
      paste(
        missing_statistics,
        collapse = ", "
      ),
      "\nFile: ",
      file
    )
  }

  identifier <- if (
    molecule == "mRNA"
  ) {
    "Gene"
  } else {
    "pre_miRNA"
  }

  data[[identifier]] <- trimws(
    as.character(
      data[[identifier]]
    )
  )

  data %>%
    mutate(
      Dataset = dataset,
      Contrast = params$contrast,
      logFC = as.numeric(logFC),
      PValue = as.numeric(PValue),
      FDR = as.numeric(FDR),
      .before = 1
    )
}
```

```{r}
read_stability_table <- function(
    file,
    molecule,
    stability_flag_column
) {
  data <- read.csv(
    file,
    check.names = FALSE,
    stringsAsFactors = FALSE
  ) %>%
    as_tibble()

  identifier_candidates <- if (
    molecule == "mRNA"
  ) {
    c(
      "Gene",
      "gene",
      "gene_symbol",
      "symbol",
      "GeneSymbol",
      "X",
      "...1"
    )
  } else {
    c(
      "pre_miRNA",
      "pre_mirna",
      "miRNA",
      "mirna",
      "Gene",
      "X",
      "...1"
    )
  }

  identifier_column <- find_column(
    data,
    identifier_candidates,
    paste0(
      molecule,
      " identifier column"
    )
  )

  canonical_identifier <- if (
    molecule == "mRNA"
  ) {
    "Gene"
  } else {
    "pre_miRNA"
  }

  names(data)[
    names(data) ==
      identifier_column
  ] <- canonical_identifier

  contrast_column <- find_column(
    data,
    c(
      "Contrast",
      "contrast",
      "Comparison",
      "comparison"
    ),
    "contrast column"
  )

  names(data)[
    names(data) ==
      contrast_column
  ] <- "Contrast"

  if (
    !stability_flag_column %in%
      names(data)
  ) {
    stop(
      "Stability flag '",
      stability_flag_column,
      "' was not found in ",
      file,
      ". Available columns: ",
      paste(
        names(data),
        collapse = ", "
      )
    )
  }

  data[[canonical_identifier]] <- trimws(
    as.character(
      data[[canonical_identifier]]
    )
  )

  data <- data %>%
    mutate(
      Contrast =
        canonical_contrast(
          Contrast
        )
    ) %>%
    filter(
      Contrast ==
        canonical_contrast(
          params$contrast
        )
    )

  duplicates <- data %>%
    count(
      .data[[
        canonical_identifier
      ]],
      name = "n"
    ) %>%
    filter(
      n > 1
    )

  if (nrow(duplicates) > 0) {
    stop(
      "Duplicate feature rows were found in stability table: ",
      file
    )
  }

  data %>%
    mutate(
      selected_stability_flag =
        as_flag(
          .data[[
            stability_flag_column
          ]]
        )
    )
}
```

```{r}
build_validated_table <- function(
    dataset,
    molecule,
    primary_file,
    stability_file,
    stability_flag_column
) {
  primary <- read_primary_de(
    primary_file,
    molecule,
    dataset
  )

  stability <- read_stability_table(
    stability_file,
    molecule,
    stability_flag_column
  )

  identifier <- if (
    molecule == "mRNA"
  ) {
    "Gene"
  } else {
    "pre_miRNA"
  }

  stability_columns <- setdiff(
    names(stability),
    c(
      identifier,
      "Contrast"
    )
  )

  stability <- stability %>%
    rename_with(
      ~ paste0(
        "stability_",
        .x
      ),
      all_of(
        stability_columns
      )
    )

  joined <- primary %>%
    left_join(
      stability,
      by = c(
        identifier,
        "Contrast"
      )
    ) %>%
    mutate(
      bootstrap_assessed =
        !is.na(
          stability_selected_stability_flag
        ),

      bootstrap_stable =
        if_else(
          bootstrap_assessed,
          stability_selected_stability_flag,
          FALSE
        ),

      primary_significant =
        !is.na(FDR) &
        FDR <= params$fdr_cutoff &
        !is.na(logFC) &
        abs(logFC) >=
          params$logfc_cutoff,

      validated_significant =
        primary_significant &
        bootstrap_stable,

      Direction = case_when(
        logFC > 0 ~
          "Up in MSS/TMB-H",

        logFC < 0 ~
          "Down in MSS/TMB-H",

        TRUE ~
          "No direction"
      ),

      Molecule = molecule
    )

  list(
    all = joined,
    validated = joined %>%
      filter(
        validated_significant
      )
  )
}
```

```{r}
precursor_to_mature_base <- function(
    precursor
) {
  trimws(
    as.character(
      precursor
    )
  ) %>%
    str_replace(
      "^hsa-mir",
      "hsa-miR"
    )
}


make_mature_candidates <- function(
    precursors
) {
  precursors <- unique(
    precursors[
      !is.na(precursors) &
      nzchar(precursors)
    ]
  )

  bind_rows(
    lapply(
      precursors,
      function(precursor) {
        mature_base <-
          precursor_to_mature_base(
            precursor
          )

        mature_candidates <- if (
          str_detect(
            mature_base,
            "-(3p|5p)$"
          )
        ) {
          mature_base
        } else {
          c(
            paste0(
              mature_base,
              "-5p"
            ),
            paste0(
              mature_base,
              "-3p"
            )
          )
        }

        tibble(
          pre_miRNA = precursor,
          mature_query =
            mature_candidates
        )
      }
    )
  ) %>%
    distinct()
}
```

```{r}
empty_multimir_table <- function() {
  tibble(
    pre_miRNA = character(),
    mature_query = character(),
    mature_mirna_id = character(),
    target_symbol = character(),
    database = character()
  )
}


query_one_mature_mirna <- function(
    pre_miRNA,
    mature_query
) {
  message(
    "Querying multiMiR: ",
    mature_query
  )

  result <- tryCatch(
    multiMiR::get_multimir(
      mirna = mature_query,
      table = "validated",
      summary = TRUE
    ),
    error = function(error) {
      message(
        "multiMiR query failed for ",
        mature_query,
        ": ",
        conditionMessage(error)
      )

      return(NULL)
    }
  )

  if (
    is.null(result) ||
    is.null(result@data) ||
    nrow(result@data) == 0
  ) {
    return(
      empty_multimir_table()
    )
  }

  result@data %>%
    as_tibble() %>%
    mutate(
      pre_miRNA = pre_miRNA,
      mature_query =
        mature_query,
      .before = 1
    )
}


get_multimir_interactions <- function(
    precursors,
    cache_file
) {
  candidates <- make_mature_candidates(
    precursors
  )

  write.csv(
    candidates,
    file.path(
      multimir_dir,
      "bootstrap_validated_pre_miRNA_mature_candidates.csv"
    ),
    row.names = FALSE
  )

  if (
    file.exists(cache_file) &&
    !params$force_multimir_query
  ) {
    message(
      "Using cached multiMiR results: ",
      cache_file
    )

    interactions <- read.csv(
      cache_file,
      check.names = FALSE,
      stringsAsFactors = FALSE
    ) %>%
      as_tibble()
  } else {
    if (!params$run_multimir) {
      stop(
        "No cached multiMiR result exists and run_multimir is FALSE."
      )
    }

    interactions <- bind_rows(
      lapply(
        seq_len(
          nrow(candidates)
        ),
        function(index) {
          query_one_mature_mirna(
            candidates$pre_miRNA[
              index
            ],
            candidates$mature_query[
              index
            ]
          )
        }
      )
    )

    write.csv(
      interactions,
      cache_file,
      row.names = FALSE
    )
  }

  required_columns <- c(
    "pre_miRNA",
    "target_symbol"
  )

  missing_columns <- setdiff(
    required_columns,
    names(interactions)
  )

  if (length(missing_columns) > 0) {
    stop(
      "multiMiR result is missing columns: ",
      paste(
        missing_columns,
        collapse = ", "
      )
    )
  }

  interactions %>%
    mutate(
      pre_miRNA = trimws(
        as.character(
          pre_miRNA
        )
      ),

      target_symbol = trimws(
        as.character(
          target_symbol
        )
      ),

      target_key = toupper(
        target_symbol
      )
    ) %>%
    filter(
      !is.na(target_symbol),
      nzchar(target_symbol)
    )
}
```

```{r}
integrate_dataset <- function(
    dataset_name,
    mirna_table,
    mrna_table,
    multimir_table
) {
  mirna_direction <- mirna_table %>%
    dplyr::select(
      pre_miRNA,
      miRNA_logFC = logFC,
      miRNA_FDR = FDR,
      miRNA_Direction =
        Direction
    ) %>%
    distinct()

  gene_direction <- mrna_table %>%
    transmute(
      target_key = toupper(
        Gene
      ),

      target_symbol_DE =
        Gene,

      gene_logFC = logFC,
      gene_FDR = FDR,
      gene_Direction =
        Direction
    ) %>%
    distinct()

  multimir_table %>%
    inner_join(
      mirna_direction,
      by = "pre_miRNA"
    ) %>%
    inner_join(
      gene_direction,
      by = "target_key"
    ) %>%
    mutate(
      Dataset = dataset_name,

      inverse_direction = case_when(
        miRNA_logFC > 0 &
          gene_logFC < 0 ~
          TRUE,

        miRNA_logFC < 0 &
          gene_logFC > 0 ~
          TRUE,

        TRUE ~
          FALSE
      ),

      .before = 1
    ) %>%
    arrange(
      target_symbol_DE,
      pre_miRNA
    )
}


summarise_supported_genes <- function(
    interactions
) {
  if (nrow(interactions) == 0) {
    return(
      tibble(
        target_symbol = character(),
        gene_logFC = numeric(),
        gene_FDR = numeric(),
        gene_Direction = character(),
        n_pre_miRNAs = integer(),
        pre_miRNAs = character(),
        mature_miRNAs = character(),
        databases = character(),
        any_inverse_direction =
          logical()
      )
    )
  }

  interactions %>%
    group_by(
      target_symbol =
        target_symbol_DE,
      gene_logFC,
      gene_FDR,
      gene_Direction
    ) %>%
    summarise(
      n_pre_miRNAs =
        n_distinct(
          pre_miRNA
        ),

      pre_miRNAs = paste(
        sort(
          unique(
            pre_miRNA
          )
        ),
        collapse = "; "
      ),

      mature_miRNAs = paste(
        sort(
          unique(
            .data[[
              mature_column
            ]]
          )
        ),
        collapse = "; "
      ),

      databases = if (
        is.null(
          database_column
        )
      ) {
        NA_character_
      } else {
        paste(
          sort(
            unique(
              .data[[
                database_column
              ]]
            )
          ),
          collapse = "; "
        )
      },

      any_inverse_direction =
        any(
          inverse_direction
        ),

      .groups = "drop"
    ) %>%
    arrange(
      gene_FDR,
      desc(
        n_pre_miRNAs
      )
    )
}
```

```{r}
shared_mirna <- inner_join(
  analysis_data$CRC$
    pre_miRNA$
    validated %>%
    dplyr::select(
      pre_miRNA,
      CRC_miRNA_logFC = logFC,
      CRC_miRNA_FDR = FDR,
      CRC_miRNA_Direction =
        Direction
    ),

  analysis_data$UCEC$
    pre_miRNA$
    validated %>%
    dplyr::select(
      pre_miRNA,
      UCEC_miRNA_logFC = logFC,
      UCEC_miRNA_FDR = FDR,
      UCEC_miRNA_Direction =
        Direction
    ),

  by = "pre_miRNA"
) %>%
  mutate(
    Direction_consistent =
      sign(
        CRC_miRNA_logFC
      ) ==
      sign(
        UCEC_miRNA_logFC
      ),

    mean_miRNA_logFC =
      rowMeans(
        cbind(
          CRC_miRNA_logFC,
          UCEC_miRNA_logFC
        )
      ),

    miRNA_Direction = case_when(
      mean_miRNA_logFC > 0 ~
        "Up in MSS/TMB-H",

      mean_miRNA_logFC < 0 ~
        "Down in MSS/TMB-H",

      TRUE ~
        "No direction"
    )
  ) %>%
  filter(
    Direction_consistent
  )


shared_mrna <- inner_join(
  analysis_data$CRC$
    mRNA$
    validated %>%
    transmute(
      target_key = toupper(
        Gene
      ),

      CRC_Gene = Gene,
      CRC_gene_logFC = logFC,
      CRC_gene_FDR = FDR,
      CRC_gene_Direction =
        Direction
    ),

  analysis_data$UCEC$
    mRNA$
    validated %>%
    transmute(
      target_key = toupper(
        Gene
      ),

      UCEC_Gene = Gene,
      UCEC_gene_logFC = logFC,
      UCEC_gene_FDR = FDR,
      UCEC_gene_Direction =
        Direction
    ),

  by = "target_key"
) %>%
  mutate(
    Direction_consistent =
      sign(
        CRC_gene_logFC
      ) ==
      sign(
        UCEC_gene_logFC
      ),

    mean_gene_logFC =
      rowMeans(
        cbind(
          CRC_gene_logFC,
          UCEC_gene_logFC
        )
      ),

    gene_Direction = case_when(
      mean_gene_logFC > 0 ~
        "Up in MSS/TMB-H",

      mean_gene_logFC < 0 ~
        "Down in MSS/TMB-H",

      TRUE ~
        "No direction"
    ),

    target_symbol =
      coalesce(
        CRC_Gene,
        UCEC_Gene
      )
  ) %>%
  filter(
    Direction_consistent
  )


shared_interactions <- multimir_edges %>%
  rename(
    target_symbol_multiMiR = target_symbol
  ) %>%
  filter(
    pre_miRNA %in% shared_mirna$pre_miRNA
  ) %>%
  inner_join(

        CRC_miRNA_FDR,
        UCEC_miRNA_FDR,
        miRNA_Direction
      ),
    by = "pre_miRNA"
  ) %>%
  inner_join(
    shared_mrna %>%
      dplyr::transmute(
        target_key,
        target_symbol_DE = target_symbol,
        CRC_gene_logFC,
        UCEC_gene_logFC,
        CRC_gene_FDR,

  mutate(

    inverse_direction = case_when(

        gene_Direction == "Down in MSS/TMB-H" ~ TRUE,

      miRNA_Direction == "Down in MSS/TMB-H" &
        gene_Direction == "Up in MSS/TMB-H" ~ TRUE,

      TRUE ~ FALSE
    ),

    .before = 1
  ) %>%
  arrange(
    target_symbol,
```

```{r}
empty_enrichment_table <- function() {
  tibble(
    Analysis = character(),
    Dataset = character(),
    Target_subset = character(),
    Gene_direction = character(),
    Correction = character(),
    Significant = logical(),
    source = character(),
    term_id = character(),
    term_name = character(),
    p_value = numeric(),
    term_size = integer(),
    query_size = integer(),
    intersection_size = integer(),
    effective_domain_size =
      integer(),
    intersection = character()
  )
}


run_gost_safe <- function(
    genes,
    background,
    analysis,
    dataset,
    target_subset,
    gene_direction,
    correction
) {
  genes <- unique(
    genes[
      !is.na(genes) &
      nzchar(genes)
    ]
  )

  background <- unique(
    background[
      !is.na(background) &
      nzchar(background)
    ]
  )

  genes <- intersect(
    genes,
    background
  )

  if (
    length(genes) <
      params$minimum_query_size
  ) {
    message(
      dataset,
      " / ",
      target_subset,
      " / ",
      gene_direction,
      ": fewer than ",
      params$minimum_query_size,
      " genes; enrichment skipped."
    )

    return(
      empty_enrichment_table()
    )
  }

  if (!params$run_gprofiler) {
    return(
      empty_enrichment_table()
    )
  }

  result <- tryCatch(
    suppressMessages(
      suppressWarnings(
        gprofiler2::gost(
          query = genes,
          organism =
            params$organism,
          ordered_query = FALSE,
          multi_query = FALSE,
          significant = FALSE,
          exclude_iea = FALSE,
          measure_underrepresentation =
            FALSE,
          evcodes = TRUE,
          user_threshold = 1,
          correction_method =
            correction,
          domain_scope =
            params$domain_scope,
          custom_bg =
            background,
          sources =
            params$enrichment_sources,
          highlight = FALSE
        )
      )
    ),
    error = function(error) {
      message(
        "g:Profiler failed for ",
        dataset,
        " / ",
        target_subset,
        " / ",
        gene_direction,
        " / ",
        correction,
        ": ",
        conditionMessage(error)
      )

      return(NULL)
    }
  )

  if (
    is.null(result) ||
    is.null(result$result) ||
    nrow(result$result) == 0
  ) {
    return(
      empty_enrichment_table()
    )
  }

  result$result %>%
    as_tibble() %>%
    mutate(
      Analysis = analysis,
      Dataset = dataset,
      Target_subset =
        target_subset,
      Gene_direction =
        gene_direction,
      Correction = correction,
      Significant =
        p_value <=
        params$fdr_cutoff,
      intersection = vapply(
        intersection,
        function(values) {
          paste(
            values,
            collapse = "; "
          )
        },
        character(1)
      ),
      .before = 1
    ) %>%
    dplyr::select(
      Analysis,
      Dataset,
      Target_subset,
      Gene_direction,
      Correction,
      Significant,
      source,
      term_id,
      term_name,
      p_value,
      term_size,
      query_size,
      intersection_size,
      effective_domain_size,
      intersection,
      everything()
    )
}


make_gene_queries <- function(
    interactions,
    gene_symbol_column,
    gene_direction_column
) {
  all_genes <- interactions %>%
    transmute(
      Gene =
        .data[[
          gene_symbol_column
        ]],

      Direction =
        .data[[
          gene_direction_column
        ]]
    ) %>%
    distinct()

  inverse_genes <- interactions %>%
    filter(
      inverse_direction
    ) %>%
    transmute(
      Gene =
        .data[[
          gene_symbol_column
        ]],

      Direction =
        .data[[
          gene_direction_column
        ]]
    ) %>%
    distinct()

  list(
    All_validated_target_overlaps =
      list(
        `Up in MSS/TMB-H` =
          all_genes %>%
          filter(
            Direction ==
              "Up in MSS/TMB-H"
          ) %>%
          pull(Gene),

        `Down in MSS/TMB-H` =
          all_genes %>%
          filter(
            Direction ==
              "Down in MSS/TMB-H"
          ) %>%
          pull(Gene)
      ),

    Inverse_direction_only =
      list(
        `Up in MSS/TMB-H` =
          inverse_genes %>%
          filter(
            Direction ==
              "Up in MSS/TMB-H"
          ) %>%
          pull(Gene),

        `Down in MSS/TMB-H` =
          inverse_genes %>%
          filter(
            Direction ==
              "Down in MSS/TMB-H"
          ) %>%
          pull(Gene)
      )
  )
}


run_query_collection <- function(
    queries,
    background,
    dataset,
    analysis
) {
  bind_rows(
    lapply(
      names(queries),
      function(target_subset) {
        bind_rows(
          lapply(
            names(
              queries[[
                target_subset
              ]]
            ),
            function(gene_direction) {
              genes <-
                queries[[
                  target_subset
                ]][[
                  gene_direction
                ]]

              bind_rows(
                run_gost_safe(
                  genes = genes,
                  background =
                    background,
                  analysis =
                    analysis,
                  dataset =
                    dataset,
                  target_subset =
                    target_subset,
                  gene_direction =
                    gene_direction,
                  correction =
                    "g_SCS"
                ),

                run_gost_safe(
                  genes = genes,
                  background =
                    background,
                  analysis =
                    analysis,
                  dataset =
                    dataset,
                  target_subset =
                    target_subset,
                  gene_direction =
                    gene_direction,
                  correction =
                    "fdr"
                )
              )
            }
          )
        )
      }
    )
  )
}
```

```{r}
flatten_list_columns <- function(df) {
  list_columns <- names(df)[
    vapply(df, is.list, logical(1))
  ]

  if (length(list_columns) == 0) {
    return(df)
  }

  df %>%
    mutate(
      across(
        all_of(list_columns),
        ~ vapply(
          .x,
          function(value) {
            if (
              is.null(value) ||
              length(value) == 0
            ) {
              return("")
            }

            paste(
              unlist(
                value,
                recursive = TRUE,
                use.names = FALSE
              ),
              collapse = "; "
            )
          },
          character(1)
        )
      )
    )
}
```

```{r}
select_top_terms <- function(
    enrichment,
    correction,
    target_subset
) {
  enrichment %>%
    filter(
      Correction ==
        correction,
      Target_subset ==
        target_subset,
      Significant
    ) %>%
    group_by(
      Dataset,
      Gene_direction,
      source
    ) %>%
    arrange(
      p_value,
      .by_group = TRUE
    ) %>%
    slice_head(
      n =
        params$top_terms_per_source
    ) %>%
    ungroup() %>%
    mutate(
      neglog10_p =
        -log10(
          pmax(
            p_value,
            1e-300
          )
        ),

      term_label = paste0(
        source,
        ": ",
        str_trunc(
          term_name,
          72
        )
      )
    )
}


plot_enrichment <- function(
    enrichment,
    correction,
    target_subset,
    title,
    output_file
) {
  plot_data <- select_top_terms(
    enrichment,
    correction,
    target_subset
  )

  if (nrow(plot_data) == 0) {
    save_placeholder_svg(
      output_file,
      title,
      paste0(
        "No significant ",
        correction,
        " terms"
      )
    )

    return(
      invisible(NULL)
    )
  }

  plot_data <- plot_data %>%
    arrange(
      Dataset,
      Gene_direction,
      p_value
    ) %>%
    mutate(
      term_label = factor(
        term_label,
        levels = rev(
          unique(
            term_label
          )
        )
      )
    )

  p <- ggplot(
    plot_data,
    aes(
      neglog10_p,
      term_label
    )
  ) +
    geom_point(
      aes(
        size =
          intersection_size,
        color =
          Gene_direction
      ),
      alpha = 0.9
    ) +
    facet_grid(
      Dataset ~ Gene_direction,
      scales = "free_y",
      space = "free_y"
    ) +
    scale_color_manual(
      values =
        direction_colors
    ) +
    labs(
      title = title,
      subtitle = paste0(
        "Correction: ",
        correction,
        "; custom background = genes tested by edgeR"
      ),
      x =
        expression(-log[10]("adjusted p-value")),
      y = NULL,
      size =
        "Target genes",
      color = NULL
    ) +
    theme_classic(
      base_size = 11
    ) +
    theme(
      plot.title = element_text(
        face = "bold",
        hjust = 0.5
      ),
      plot.subtitle = element_text(
        hjust = 0.5
      ),
      strip.text = element_text(
        face = "bold"
      ),
      legend.position = "right"
    )

  ggsave(
    output_file,
    p,
    width = 12,
    height = max(
      7,
      0.22 *
        nrow(
          plot_data
        )
    ),
    device = "svg",
    limitsize = FALSE
  )

  invisible(p)
}
```
